limitations.note: The patch clocked the rotation of `q` but left `data` combinational, so it showed the post-rotation bit instead of capturing the pre-edge bit and led the required sequence by one clock.
The test counted the reset-state zero as the first sequence bit and expected the second bit on the first rising edge after reset, so it passed the phase error instead of catching it.

limitations.quote: preserve the established output latency and reset values unless the specification explicitly changes them
limitations.note: The agent read relevant latency guidance, but it did not prompt a check of whether `data` needed to capture `q[5]` before the rotation.
